content:
The **Ultracite Gatling Laser** is a heavy gun in *Fallout 76*.

## Gameplay[edit]

A Gatling Laser modified with ultracite crystal conduits, the gun is a large, two-handed weapon consisting of four rotating barrels that fire yellow-green laser pulses through two lenses. It uses Fusion Cores for ammunition. Each Fusion Core provides 500 shots. It has a high rate of fire but low accuracy, making it more useful for highly concentrated groups of enemies.

The Gatling laser has more damage and accuracy than a tri-barrel minigun, so this is a viable choice should one desire more accuracy and damage per magazine. Its ammo is considerably more cost-efficient than a minigun's, so this is also good for player characters on a budget that doesn't accommodate for 5mm Rounds, but makes Fusion Cores affordable.

Compared to the Gatling Laser, the Ultracite Gatling Laser has a higher damage per shot. This is in contrast to standard laser guns where the ultracite laser gun tends to have lower base damage but a higher rate of fire than the standard model.

## Locations[edit]

Can be crafted from the plan, which is a rare drop from Cranberry Bog events.

- Reloading behavior can lead to an inventory full of partially-used cores if frequently swapping between weapons or manually reloading.
- The weapon is affected by the Grounded mutation.
